text: michelle: quick design review 7 playground chat UI iteration. primary concerns: live streaming UI, a clear stop/regenerate affordance, token counter placement for compact/wide layouts, and prompt library quick-insert behavior. dropping initial mocks + thoughts below. please reply with accessibility nits and copy suggestions. sam: love direction. main ask: make stop control discoverable while streaming. users panic if they can't halt output. :eyes: keep it simple. jorge: agree on stop visibility but worried about visual clutter in compact view. propose an icon-only control that expands on hover/focus to show label. alex: sketched two patterns: (A) inline control attached to the streaming bubble (small icon cluster), (B) persistent footer toolbar with Stop / Regenerate / Retry grouped. Inline keeps context but may be hard on touch. Footer is clear but uses screen space. ascii mock below: [Bubble] Streaming token flow... [Stop] [Regen] -------------------------------- | tokens: 98 | Prompt Library [insert] alex: for compact mode we can collapse tokens to an icon with badge; tapping reveals exact count. katie: accessibility notes: if stop is inline, ensure it's reachable by keyboard immediately after the message. use aria-label="Stop streaming response". announce streaming start/stop via live region. michelle: microcopy tweak: prefer explicit verbs "Stop streaming", "Regenerate response", and "Retry" (define Retry = re-run same request). For prompt lib actions: "Insert and edit" vs "Insert & send". jorge: token counter: prefer per-response token count by default, with tooltip for session total. less noisy for multi-turn chats. sam: telemetry thing: add events for which stop control gets used (inline vs footer) and whether users choose insert+send often. we'll A/B test. alex: developer snippet suggestion: tokens: 98 alex: also add an announcement when streaming ends: notify('Streaming complete 98 tokens'). Screen reader will pick it up. katie: prompt library modal must trap focus, role=dialog, aria-modal=true, and clearly announce selected prompt. keyboard shortcut to open: Ctrl/Cmd+K. michelle: contrast nit flagged purple token badge in dark theme fails small-text ratio; jorge can run contrast pass. figma-bot: New comment on frame "Playground/Streaming v5": https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-stream-v5 check comments 2,4. michelle: decisions: widescreen = persistent footer toolbar; compact = inline icon-only stop + token badge with hover/tap reveal. Action owners: alex update mocks, jorge contrast pass, katie write ARIA spec + keyboard flow, sam wire telemetry, i'll schedule 30m sync tomorrow. thanks! :tada:
